corrections.original: The sample standard deviation can be interpreted as an unbiased estimator of the population standard deviation.
corrections.replacement: For independent, identically distributed observations with finite variance, the sample variance calculated with n − 1 in the denominator is an unbiased estimator of population variance. Taking its square root does not preserve unbiasedness: the sample standard deviation is generally downward biased as an estimator of population standard deviation.
corrections.reason: Corrected source error: unbiased sample variance does not imply unbiased sample standard deviation.
